subject: Clarification on onboarding evidence: training dates vs BG windows
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: BrightBank Audit <audit@brightbank.com>; Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@brightbank.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Clarification on onboarding evidence: training dates vs BG windows

Hi Kelly / BrightBank team,

Thanks for the initial request list. We pulled the training/completion export and the background‑check summaries for the last 12 months, but noticed a potential discrepancy between the BG vendor timestamps and the LMS completion dates for a small set of hires (5 users).

Before we hand over the full package, could you confirm whether the auditor prefers: 
- raw BG vendor timestamps (UTC) or the vendor summary PDF (which we can redact PII from), and
- LMS export with full timestamps or a redacted per-user "completion verified" sheet?

We want to avoid repeated transmittals. Attaching a small sample: training_completion_export_20260628.csv (first 10 rows) and bg_check_summary_redacted.pdf (redacted summary).

Also, two quick notes:
- The hires in question joined via contractor conversion; their offer date and actual system onboarding dates differ by 3–7 days, which may explain the mismatch.
- We will include the deprovisioning timeline for the same cohort if that helps tie the chain of custody.

Planned timeline: if you confirm format preferences, we can assemble the full packet by Friday (2026‑07‑02).

Thanks,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: training_completion_export_20260628.csv (csv), bg_check_summary_redacted.pdf (pdf)

From: Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@brightbank.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBank Audit <audit@brightbank.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on onboarding evidence: training dates vs BG windows

Hi Rohan —

Thanks for the sample. For SOC 2 validation we need the following: 
1) BG vendor raw timestamps (UTC) for the subject checks plus the vendor verification log (we can accept a vendor CSV).
2) LMS export with full timestamps for completion (we can redact PII but need exact datetimes).
3) Deprovisioning events for users who left within 90 days.

If PII redaction is required, please include an index file that maps redacted IDs to auditor IDs under a separate secure channel (we prefer DocuSign envelope for attestations or an SFTP link).

Also confirm whether contractor conversions are processed by HR or Procurement; we'll want the offer -> start -> access grant sequence for each of the five users.

If you can deliver the full package by COB Friday (2026‑07‑02) we'll keep the audit on schedule.

Regards,
Kelly
Kelly Tran
Senior IT Audit, BrightBank

---
BrightBank Audit (audit@brightbank.com)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on onboarding evidence: training dates vs BG windows

Thanks Kelly — quick update from our side.

We can provide: 
- Vendor CSV from VeriCert with raw timestamps (attached sample was redacted — full file available).
- LMS export (CSV) with ISO timestamps; we will produce a second file with PII redacted plus a mapping index that will be shared via DocuSign secure link.
- Deprovisioning log (system events) exported from the access management service for the last 12 months.

Question about attestation: do you require an HR-signed attestation for contractor conversions specifically, or will a People Ops email thread plus the HR system record suffice? If required, we can route a signature request via DocuSign.

Attaching: onboard_deprovision_timeline.xlsx (small extract) and a short readme describing redaction approach.

On the five flagged users: three were contractor -> full-time conversions (HR processed), two were direct hires with delayed vendor responses. We'll produce the timeline per user in the packet.

Soojin

Redwood Inference
